findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous subprocess usage in wheel.
 * @description Find direct uses of subprocess in wheel package (no dataflow).
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/wheel-subprocess-direct
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from API::CallNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["run", "Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall()
select call, "Direct subprocess invocation in wheel package."
findings.hypothesis: Direct subprocess calls which may take untrusted inputs in wheel CLI utilities.

/**

 * @id py/wheel-subprocess-summary
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["run", "Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall()
select call, "Direct subprocess invocation in wheel package (summary query)."
findings.hypothesis: Map all subprocess.* calls for manual review of command construction and inputs.
